capability: Track-52 live wgpu or CUDA hardware parity and benchmark proof.

hardware.memory_topology: Replace with NUMA node, host memory size, and host/device locality topology.
hardware.accelerator_model: Replace with exact GPU model, backend target, device ID, and VRAM size.
hardware.driver: Replace with graphics or CUDA driver/runtime version.

system.operating_system: Replace with OS image, kernel/build, architecture, and GPU runtime stack.

toolchain.compiler: Replace with shader compiler, CUDA compiler, C/C++ compiler, and relevant SDK versions.
toolchain.mpi_implementation: none for single-node Track 52 hardware proof unless the run is launched under MPI.
toolchain.scheduler: Replace with local shell, Slurm allocation, CI runner, Kubernetes job, or provider scheduler.

runtime.command: Replace with the exact cargo test or benchmark command used to generate the raw artifact.

environment.RUSTFLAGS: Replace with effective value or none.
environment.WGPU_BACKEND: Replace with Vulkan, Metal, DX12, or none for CUDA.
environment.CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES: Replace with effective value or none for wgpu-only runs.

runtime.input_scenario: Replace with DES, ABM, mixed parity, persistent-memory, or benchmark scenario and seed manifest.

storage.filesystem_or_object_store: Replace with local disk, CI artifact store, Lustre, GPFS, or provider object store details.

result.expected: Replace with parity tolerance, copy-boundary expectation, resident-buffer expectation, and benchmark threshold.
result.observed: Replace with measured parity result, raw timings, memory residency counters, device metadata, and speedup or no-speedup result.
result.raw_artifact_path: Replace with immutable raw output, command capture, environment capture, and benchmark result bundle path.

review.reviewer: Replace with reviewer name or handle.

waiver.expires: Replace with none for real live-hpc evidence; template must be copied and completed before any hardware claim.
